alt.zh: 人物走过赭色庭院的墙根。

credit.en: Original AI concept photographs. Fictional field studies.
credit.zh: 原创 AI 概念摄影。场景为虚构练习。

kicker.zh: 建筑摄影 / 光线手记

body.en: An afternoon exercise in finding scale and direction.
body.zh: 一个下午，练习用光线交代尺度与方向。

notes.en: Ask the audience where their eye first lands in the courtyard.
notes.zh: 请观众说出第一眼看到的地方。

title.zh:
等一个人，
走进光里。

body.en: A wall alone hides its height. A figure at its base gives the eye a unit of measure.
body.zh: 一面空墙很难交代高度。等一个人走到墙根，画面自然就有了尺度。

notes.en: Point to the figure at the foot of the wall.
notes.zh: 指出墙根的人物，让观众比较人与墙的高度。

kicker.zh: 接触印样 / 两张习作

title.en: Two ways to direct the eye.

body.en: Trace the shadow boundary, then follow the stairs uphill.
body.zh: 先沿明暗交界移动视线，再顺着台阶向上看。

notes.en: Discuss where the eye enters and exits each image.
notes.zh: 请观众指出每张图中视线的入口与出口。

alt.en: A walker beneath an ochre wall.
alt.zh: 人物走过赭色庭院的墙根。

alt.en: Cool blue stairs in side light.

label.zh: B / 沿对角线移动视线

body.en: Make one frame with a person for scale, then one with a line for direction.
body.zh: 用一个人物交代尺度，再用一条线带出方向。把两张照片并排看。

notes.en: Invite the audience to save the two study locations in the mobile prototype.
notes.zh: 邀请观众打开机位手记，收藏下次想练习的机位。
